description:
A wonderful Club Assembly successfully concluded!

A heartfelt thank you to all our members for joining and making the evening meaningful. Special gratitude to AG Arun Wadhwa Ji for gracing the occasion and enlightening us with his valuable insights about Rotary. His guidance and encouraging words truly inspired us all.
